messages:
Samir Patel: Heads up — Azure portal is rejecting our new private offer because the attestation template the merchant uploaded doesn't include the new data_privacy_fields. We need a stopgap.

Jess Chen: Ugh. Which fields exactly?

Samir Patel: portal error: "missing field: data_privacy_contact_email". Their UI accepts upload but the backend validation fails. Screenshot attached in thread (merchant says it looks fine).

Cal Ndlovu: tagging @Maria — is this the attestation clause Legal pushed last quarter? Could be a schema mismatch.

Maria Gomez: Yup, Legal updated the attestation in Jan. We require both contact email and an attestation_signature_type ("electronic"|"wet"), plus timestamp. Merchant probably used old template.

Jess Chen: Can we accept old template manually so onboarding doesn't stall? Marketplace team wants to publish by EOD for co-marketing.

Maria Gomez: We can onboard manually but we need a signed attestation on file before revenue recognition. Options: 1) manual override + merchant to send signed PDF to compliance@, or 2) ask merchant to resubmit matching JSON schema.

Samir Patel: Merchant prefers quick workaround. They can email a signed PDF. Do we have an intake flow for manual uploads that maps to portal records?

Partnerships Bot: Marketplace Portal: Automated validation failed (code 422) for offer id: OFR-98765 — reason: missing field data_privacy_contact_email.

Cal Ndlovu: Ops notes: we can accept PDFs but need to record metadata. @Jess can you confirm BizOps will accept an emailed PDF and we will ingest it into the contract locker?

Jess Chen: Yes, BizOps can accept emailed PDF for now. Need merchant to include: offer id, legal entity name, signer name, signer title. I'll draft the email template.

Maria Gomez: Also ask them to indicate attestation_signature_type. If they choose electronic, include the signing tool and timestamp. If wet, scan with visible signature and date.

Samir Patel: Sending merchant a short how-to now. Will request FAA-style attestation snippet for quick copy/paste.

Samir Patel: Message to merchant (sent): 
Hi team — to unblock the portal we can accept a signed PDF sent to compliance@redwood.ai. Please include the following attestation text and signer details. Example you can paste into a PDF:

---
I, [Signer Name], on behalf of [Merchant Legal Name], attest that: 
1) We comply with applicable data protection laws for offers published in the Azure Marketplace.
2) Contact for data privacy matters: [email@domain.com].
3) Attestation signature type: [electronic|wet].
Signed: [Signer Name], [Title], Date: [YYYY-MM-DD]
---

We will then upload to the portal and finish the listing.

Merchant (reply): Got it. We'll send a scanned signed pdf within 2 hours. Do you need anything else? :thumbsup:

Jess Chen: That's perfect. Once we get it, I'll coordinate with Ops to bypass the automated validation and attach metadata.

Partnerships Bot: Marketplace Portal: Manual attachment request queued to compliance; please cc bizops@redwood.ai when emailing.

Maria Gomez: One more ask — update our public attestation JSON schema in the docs (internal link) so merchant-facing templates are current. I’ll file a doc PR after this.

Cal Ndlovu: Noted. Also let's add an engineer ticket to make portal validation error messages show the missing field name prominently (merchant couldn't find it).

Samir Patel: Filing ticket now: 
```
Title: Portal validation: surface missing JSON fields in upload flow
Priority: P2
Description: backend returns 422 with field names but UI hides them. Show explicit guidance and link to attestation schema.
```

Jess Chen: Thanks. Will monitor merchant email and update thread.

Merchant (later): Email sent to compliance@, attached signed PDF and included offer id.

Jess Chen: Received. Uploading to portal manual queue and creating internal record.

Partnerships Bot: Marketplace Portal: Manual upload complete for offer id OFR-98765, status: pending-legal-review.

Maria Gomez: I'll review the attestation and confirm. If anything missing I'll flag.

Samir Patel: Great — thanks everyone for the quick turnaround :rocket:
